ideas.pitch: An open-source telemetry and compliance governance proxy for multi-tenant LLM applications.
ideas.title: CloudPolicy Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the Genuinely hard engineering pattern by solving runtime AI governance and cost optimization locally without third-party SaaS lock-in.

ideas.pitch: A training-free, self-improving semantic routing proxy using kNN over exemplar indexes to slash LLM API costs.
ideas.title: SemanticRouter Lite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors a first-prize winning architecture by demonstrating immediate, quantifiable cost and latency reductions using an innovative routing mechanism.

ideas.pitch: A BPMN-orchestrated pre-deployment risk diagnosis tool that runs automated compliance checks on AI workflows.
ideas.title: BPMN Risk Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines visual workflow orchestration with rigorous human-in-the-loop validation, appealing directly to enterprise judges looking for practical safety measures.

ideas.pitch: An optimization layer that accelerates LLM reasoning loops through advanced state caching and reinforcement learning principles.
ideas.title: HyperReason Cache
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on raw technical performance and deep optimization, aligning with the winning pattern of solving complex computational bottlenecks.

ideas.pitch: An offline AI code review assistant built to run locally on resource-constrained environments.
ideas.title: EdgeCode Reviewer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases offline-first deployment capabilities, which impress judges by solving privacy and latency issues inherent in cloud-only solutions.
